page.title: A 16-week marathon plan for busy people
page.text: This plan builds from 30 to 70 kilometres a week over sixteen weeks. Long runs grow by two kilometres each fortnight, with a cut-back week every fourth week. Two short sessions a week are enough if the long run is protected. Strength work twice a week reduces injury. Taper for the final two weeks.
